name: overlay-routing-toast-dialog-sync
description: The page lays out the surfaces while an error toast is shown and a dialog surface is open, and the sync request carries the rectangle of the toast as a window overlay with cut true, so the container of the surface hosts, the dialog host included, leaves out the toast and the toast is drawn above the dialog; the host answers with no placement and the window chrome.
reason: syncSurfaces places native surfaces in a window, and only the native host with a window produces its answer (the native tier of docs/operations/examples.md#test-kinds).
